statements.t: Patients and physicians are still waiting for effective non-opioid treatment options for both acute and chronic pain, and we look forward to sharing progress from both programs as we advance our development efforts.”

The Company plans to add an active opioid comparator arm of oxycodone/acetaminophen (commonly known as Percocet) to the bunionectomy trial providing additional data to strengthen potential opioid-sparing label claims against a more potent, commonly used opioid compared to the opioid comparator utilized in abdominoplasty, hydrocodone/acetaminophen (commonly known as Vicodin).

risks.t: that the Company has limited operating history and no history of commercializing products
that the Company has incurred substantial losses since its inception and may never achieve or maintain profitability
that the Company will require substantial additional financing to achieve its goals
risk that results of earlier studies and trials may not be predictive of future trials or real-world results
risks related to the legal and regulatory framework for the industry, and potential exposure to legal proceedings, regulatory inquiries, and other legal matters
